metadata.title: Main Bhi Bharat।PARTICULARLY VULNERABLE TRIBAL GROUPS (PVTG) GOING HUNGRY ।आदिवासियों में बढ़ी भूख
metadata.description:
A recent study has revealed that the tribal population, especially the Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTG) have been the worst affected by the covid-induced lockdown. 77% of these tribals do not have enough food to eat. This study also says that women and children from the PVTGs  are the most affected. This study was conducted in 11 states of India.
